entries.title: Claude accounts settings
entries.text: Opens Settings → Plugins → Claude accounts.

entries.title: Switch Claude account
entries.text: Opens the list of saved Claude accounts with a Switch button on each.

entries.title: Claude accounts
entries.text: Which Claude login the VPS uses. New launches use the active account; running builds keep theirs.

entries.title: Switch
entries.text: Asks to switch Claude on the VPS to this account. It waits for your approval, then new launches use it.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Asks to save the login Claude is signed in with on the VPS under this name. It waits for your approval.

entries.title: Save current login as…
entries.text: The name for the login. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, up to 32.

entries.title: New Claude Code terminal
entries.text: Opens a new Claude Code tab. Pick the VPS host, then run /login to add an account.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads the accounts from the VPS again.

entries.title: Claude accounts
entries.text: Settings for which Claude login the VPS uses: list, switch, save the current login.

entries.title: Switch Claude account
entries.text: The saved Claude accounts with a Switch button on each. A switch waits for your approval.

entries.title: Make worker
entries.text: Turns this account into a worker: it only runs headless jobs and is never the console's account.

entries.title: Stop worker
entries.text: Stops sending headless jobs to this account. Running jobs finish where they are.

entries.title: Sign in
entries.text: Signs this account in, in its own folder, so the active login isn't touched. Use it for a new account or when a login expired. Asks for approval, then opens in the Terminal.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Sets this saved account aside on the VPS. Nothing is deleted. The active account and one running a job can't be removed.

entries.title: Add and sign in
entries.text: Creates a new account folder and starts its sign-in. Once it's signed in, tap Make worker on its row.

entries.title: New account name
entries.text: The name for the new account: lower-case letters, digits and dashes.

entries.title: Claude job routing settings
entries.text: Opens Settings → Plugins → Claude accounts, where Job routing decides which account takes each headless job.

entries.title: Job routing
entries.text: Every saved subscription login takes headless jobs unless you stop it; the console's account takes jobs after them when its switch is on. At most 3 jobs build and 5 wait per account. API keys bill per token, so they only take jobs a routing rule sends them, and nothing once a daily or weekly spend cap is reached. Rules are checked in order and the first switched-on match decides. Test a job shows where a job would go right now.

entries.title: Bring back
entries.text: Takes this account back into the job rotation now, e.g. after you signed it in or topped it up. Its phone alert closes. A login signed in again comes back by itself within a minute anyway.

entries.title: Move a build when its account stops it
entries.text: When a build dies on an account's login, usage limit or credits, the account is taken out and the build starts again on the next account the routing rules allow. Off = the build stops there.

entries.title: Most moves per build
entries.text: How many times one build may move to another account before it stops (0 to 20).

entries.title: Wait for an account (minutes)
entries.text: When every account is out, the build waits this long for one to come back instead of stopping. 0 = stop at once.

entries.title: Phone alert on every account problem
entries.text: Sends an AmberX alert when an account stops a build: which account, what failed, where the build moved and what to do. It closes when the account works again.

entries.title: Also for limits that end by themselves
entries.text: Off = a usage limit that resets on its own doesn't buzz your phone; dead logins, no credits and builds with nowhere to go still do.

entries.title: Check where each login is kept
entries.text: Lists every place a Claude login is kept on the VPS (its home, the console's login, each build's copy) and whether each is in step with its home. Shows token hashes only.

entries.title: Console account takes headless jobs
entries.text: Turns “Console account takes headless jobs” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Claude accounts.

entries.title: Jobs building at once, per account

entries.title: Failover & alerts
entries.text: Which Claude accounts are out, why and until when, what moved where, each login's last token refresh, and what happens when an account stops a build: move it, wait for an account, phone alerts.

entries.title: Account checks
entries.text: What the last health check found for every Claude account: ok, limited, no credits or login expired; 5-hour and weekly use left with resets; API spend against its caps; the models it can use now. Builds only go to an account this says can take them. Checks run on a schedule and when a console opens.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Asks the VPS to check every Claude account now. It starts within a minute (the host's minute sweep picks it up); the result lands here and on your phone. About a tenth of a cent per account.

entries.title: Check
entries.text: Checks just this account now (starts within a minute).

entries.title: Check every account on a schedule
entries.text: On: the VPS checks every account at the interval below, a tiny bare session per subscription and the free usage and models reads. Off: only console openings, Check now and failed builds update the status.

entries.title: Check when a console opens
entries.text: Opening the console asks for a check, unless the last one is newer than the gap. Sends the before and after phone notifications when those are on.

entries.title: Check every (minutes)
entries.text: Minutes between scheduled checks, 10 to 1440. Default 60.

entries.title: Gap after a check (minutes)
entries.text: A console opening within this many minutes of the last check doesn't start another. 0 to 240, default 15.

entries.title: Prove each subscription login with a tiny session
entries.text: A one-line headless Claude session with no rules, no CLAUDE.md, no MCP and no tools: about 360 tokens, nothing extra on a subscription. It is the only way to catch a login that died, and it renews the login's token into its one home.

entries.title: Prove each API key with a 1-token message
entries.text: About $0.0001 per key. Anthropic has no balance API, so this is how an API key that is out of credits shows up. Off: only the free models list (catches a revoked key).

entries.title: Phone notification before and after a check
entries.text: AmberX gets "checking 4 Claude accounts" when a check starts and one line per account when it ends, plus what to do (sign an account in, top one up). Type account-status in the Notifications panel.

entries.title: Alert when a check finds an account down
entries.text: One phone alert per problem (login expired, limited, no credits), the same alert a failed build raises. It closes by itself when the account works again.
